Print_Text_EHE.EvacuationFlyer_info:
Below the header is the seal of the Department of the Army, United States of America, 1775.

THIS AREA HAS BEEN DESIGNATED AS A FREE FIRE ZONE. MILITARY OPERATIONS WILL BE CONDUCTED TO CULL THE INFECTED IN THE AREA.

IMMEDIATELY DEPART FROM ALL URBAN AREAS AND AREAS DECLARED ABANDONED. YOU ARE IMMEDIATELY ADVISED TO LEAVE THE AREA AND SEEK PROTECTED SHELTER.

OPERATIONS WILL COMMENCE IMMEDIATELY AFTER THE WARNING SIREN.

THERE WILL BE NO FURTHER WARNINGS; MAKE PREPARATIONS NOW.
Print_Text_EHE.PreventionFlyer_info:
PREVENTION
Wear a face covering at all times. Do not attempt to communicate with the infected. Avoid bites and scratches and wear protective clothing.

IDENTIFICATION
Inattention toward grievous injury. Uncoordinated movement. Homicidal aggression.

PROTECT YOURSELF
Within three hours of expiry, all subjects will reanimate and relentlessly attempt acts of homicide until termination. Immediately isolate the infected away from living conditions. Do not attempt at anytime to reason with the infected.

Below the text is the seal of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.
Print_Text_EHE.EmergencyFlyer_info:
The seal of the Department of the Army sits above the header.

LOOTING AND VIGILANTISM WILL BE TREATED WITH LETHAL FORCE.

ALL INHABITANTS ARE ADVISED TO REMAIN INDOORS UNLESS DEEMED ABSOLUTELY NECESSARY.

DO NOT INTERFERE WITH ARMED PATROLS. LOCK ALL ENTRY WAYS AND REMAIN HIDDEN.

BE PREPARED TO SURRENDER ANIMALS FOR SUMMARY EXTERMINATION.

REMAIN INSIDE UNTIL THE ALL CLEAR IS GIVEN. ATTEMPTS TO BREACH THE PERIMETER WILL BE TREATED WITH LETHAL FORCE.
Print_Text_EHE.QuarantineFlyer_info:
The seal of the Department of the Army sits above the header.

DO NOT IMPEDE OR INTERFERE WITH PATROLS. DO NOT APPROACH ANY MILITARY POSITION UNLESS EXPLICITLY INSTRUCTED OTHERWISE.

BRANDISHING WEAPONS TOWARD PATROLS WILL BE CONSIDERED A HOSTILE ACT.

AVOID CONTACT WITH AFFECTED INDIVIDUALS. DO NOT HARBOR OR SHARE YOUR SHELTER WITH ANY AFFECTED INDIVIDUAL. MAKE NO ATTEMPT TO COMMUNICATE WITH ANY AFFECTED INDIVIDUAL.

WE ARE HERE FOR YOUR SAFETY.
Print_Text_EHE.NoticeFlyer_info:
Upon receiving this package it is a fact that either: the United States has sustained a nuclear attack, an enemy invasion is under way, a disaster of unknown type has occurred, or a collapse of major social order has occurred in a wide area.

WHAT YOU CAN DO: use the contents to sustain yourself and others. Direct civil authorities to disaster zones, stay alert of official instructions, and be available for rescue and relief operations on request.

IN CASE OF MASS CASUALTIES: separate from living conditions, isolate from food and water sources, assign identification to casualties.
IN CASE OF RADIATION: seek shelter in concrete structures, do not consume unsealed food or drink from outside sources, remove contaminated clothing.
IN CASE OF IMMEDIATE DANGER: vacate the area immediately, seek safety in groups, do not go out at night.

In the event of the declaration of martial law: requisitioning of private property may occur, immediate federalization of law enforcement and firefighting personnel, temporary suspension of civil liberties for the duration of the emergency.

Below the text is the seal of the Federal Emergency Management Agency.

DO YOUR PART. STAY ALERT. STAY ALIVE.
